title: Neon Nights
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished "Neon Nights" key-art image, WIDE 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: retro-futurist waterfront boulevard at midnight, Art Deco facades outlined in electric cyan and magenta neon, distant violet skyline, silhouetted palms, rain-wet pavement reflecting pink/cyan light. Deep navy-purple shadows with restrained amber accents. Background architecture has no lettered shop signs.
Subject: one ORIGINAL unbranded low wedge-shaped midnight-blue sports car with polished black glass, neon magenta/cyan reflections and subtle cyan underglow, three-quarter front view, wheels and full body visible. Compact, at most 35% image width, situated in lower-middle-right, fully inside x55–87%, y48–78%. No people, no license plate writing, no brand emblem.
Composition/framing: spacious wide2:1, large two-line title in quiet navy sky at x15–54%, y26–62%, balanced with car. All title and car entirely within central 80% width /70% height; generous scene margins. Reflected neon adds depth without obscuring title. No big oversized close-up.
Style/medium: sophisticated original illustrated game key art, painterly polished surfaces, crisp silhouette and carefully controlled neon glow. Premium cohesive catalogue feel, not a screenshot or crude clipart.
Text (verbatim): "Neon Nights". Exactly these two words once, large elegant retro Art Deco lettering with bright pale-pink letter faces, magenta outer glow and thin cyan dimensional edges, readable and uncluttered at 256x128.
Constraints: no extra text or numerals, no slogans/payout promises, no reels, fake interface, buttons, logos or watermark, no money piles, no unrelated cultural/religious imagery. One image only.
editPrompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, Neon Nights title card.
Change ONLY the sports car: remove the tiny badge/emblem at the center of its hood and any wheel-center badges so all panels and hubs are plain and unbranded. Scale the whole car to 90% of its current size, preserving angle and position center, so the car fits fully inside x45–88% width and y55–82% height. Repaint exposed pavement/reflections consistently. Preserve exact neon "Neon Nights" title and its size/position, blue/magenta/cyan palette, boulevard, palms, skyline, lighting, opaque wide 2:1 canvas. No new lettering or logos.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected final master and 768x384 WebP. Exact Neon Nights lettering, pink/cyan neon palette, Art Deco waterfront/palms and unbranded low wedge sports car preserve identity. Removed generated hood/hub emblem; no extra signage, UI or claims.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected 256x128. Both title words clear, car silhouette distinct.
visualCheck.crop: Title and full car fit central 80% width /70% height after car reduction; reflections and city continue to edges.
